title: refactor(objectql): move five delete-cascade bodies out of engine.ts into engine-delete-cascade.ts (#25522 cut 19)
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuAu38qzG6MovVEhL1F1uy7R)_ Part of #25522 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6348891160 + 6441032442 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts`「删除级联与引用遍历」区里 5 个方法体（级联删除集合的收集遍历 `collectCascadeDeleteSet`、级联内 `restrict` 判定 `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade`、`409 DELETE_RESTRICTED` 拒绝的构造 `deleteRestrictedError`、引用探测过滤 `referenceProbeFilter`、引用检查提权记录 `recordReferenceCheckElevation`）原样搬进新文件 `engine-delete-cascade.ts`；类上的方法签名、注释、位置不变，方法体换成转交。只被搬走代码读的顶层 helper `cascadeReachOf` 随之搬走；与留下代码共用的 4 个 helper 和 `CascadeDeleteSet` 类型原地加 `export`、由新文件导入（不复制）。`engine.ts` 22,110 → 21,874 行。 - **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 19 刀。此区此前因 #26930 在改而被排除，现已空出。重新测价：区内 24 个成员里，读私有静态成员的 10 个方法（含 `walkReferencingRelations`、`cascadeDeleteRelations`、`planCascadeAtomicity`）和 7 个私有静态本身按系列限制必须留下，`cascadeRelationBehavior` 因 `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` 按同文件读 `via` helper 也留下，所以实际可搬的是 5 个付得起转交成本的方法体，净 −236 行（不是派单估计的 18 个 / 约 1,069 行）。 - **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件与基线逐字节相同（含阳性对照）；运行期导出名单与函数名相同；构建产物只多出新文件一个区段，外部包首次加载顺序不变；一次性晚绑定探针在新旧两版构建产物上逐行一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-cascade.ts`（5 个函数与 `DeleteCascadeHost`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里 5 个转交桩、新导入行与 5 处原地 `export`、`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` 第 29 行登记的锚点改指新文件。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-cascade-delete.test.ts src/engine-cascade-delete-sibling-restrict.test.ts src/engine-cascade-delete-tree.test.ts`，应见三个文件全部通过（级联收集、同级 restrict 判定与拒绝信封各自走到的测试）。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 Cut 19 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`), under the claim `6487687348`. Five bodies of the "Delete cascade and reference walking" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-cascade.ts`, behind `DeleteCascadeHost`. No behaviour changes. Every published declaration file is byte-identical to the base. #25522 stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-f9p63p` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `c4c515ad3c`, with `origin/main` `7e200b4a68` merged in before this PR was opened (that merge touched none of this diff's paths). ## What changes ### Why this area, and why only five bodies The claim names this section: it was excluded from cuts 17 and 18 while #26930 was open in it, and #26930 and #27073 have since merged. Its old price (−248) was stale, so it was re-priced member by member on `c4c515ad3c` (`engine.ts` 22,110 lines, blob `50a504332d70`). The section runs from `planCascadeAtomicity` to `organizationOwnedRowCounts` (base lines 17,647 to 19,591) and holds 27 members. | member | body lines | disposition | |---|---|---| | `planCascadeAtomicity` | 81 | stays: reads the private statics `MAX_CASCADE_DEPTH`; also a liveness / reader-test site | | `warnCascadeNotAtomic` | 12 | stays: a host of three members costs 10 lines, pays 2 | | `referenceProbeFilter` | 13 | **moves** (reads no member; direct call), −11 | | `storedReferenceIncludes`, `remainderAfterMemberRemoval`, `referenceCheckContext` | 7, 2, 1 | stay: private statics | | `recordReferenceCheckElevation` | 24 | **moves**, −18 (its system-context census row is re-keyed) | | `dependentCountIsDisclosable` | 49 | stays: reads the private static `storedReferenceIncludes` | | `cascadeDeleteRelations` | 45 | stays: reads `MAX_CASCADE_DEPTH`; `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` names `engine.ts#cascadeDeleteRelations` | | `REFERENCE_PROBE_BATCH` | - | stays: private static | | `collectCascadeDeleteSet` | 64 | **moves**, −57 | | `cascadeRelationBehavior` | 60 | stays: `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` checks the `organizationOwnedRowCounts` row's `via: 'cascadeRelationBehavior'` by reading that helper in the SAME file as the site; moving it would mean changing the test's logic, not re-keying a row | | `fileReferenceCheckElevation` | 4 | stays: pays nothing (stub 5 lines) | | `probeReferencingRows` | 100 | stays: reads `referenceCheckContext`, `storedReferenceIncludes` | | `referenceProbeFilterOfSet` | 8 | stays: pays 3 | | `probeReferencingRowsOfSet` | 38 | stays: reads `REFERENCE_PROBE_BATCH` | | `walkReferencingRelations` | 318 | stays: reads `keepsOrganizationReference`, `remainderAfterMemberRemoval` | | `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade` | 74 | **moves**, −65 | | `deleteRestrictedError` | 81 | **moves**, −74 | | `isTenantColumnSetNull` | 5 | stays: pays 3, and a reader-test key names it | | `outlivesOrganization`, `keepsOrganizationReference`, `organizationCountContext` | 2, 2, 5 | stay: private statics | | `countReferencingRowsOutside` | 11 | stays: reads `organizationCountContext` | | `organizationCountIsDisclosable` | 9 | stays: pays 2 | | `refuseOrganizationDeleteWhileOwned` | 38 | stays: reads `outlivesOrganization` | | `organizationOwnedRowCounts` | 23 | stays: reads `outlivesOrganization`, `organizationCountContext`; public | So the order's hypothesis ("~18 movable bodies, ~1,069 lines") does not hold: the series limit on private statics keeps 17 members, the largest body (`walkReferencingRelations`, 318 lines) among them, and the five that move pay −225 in bodies, −236 in all. One PR, under 3,000 changed lines (753), so no further split was needed. ### The shape - The class keeps all five methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. A body becomes one host literal of exactly the `DeleteCascadeHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 19]`, as cuts 8 and 10 to 18 did. `referenceProbeFilter` reads no member, so its stub calls the function directly. The one field read (`logger`, by `recordReferenceCheckElevation`) goes as a getter over a `readLogger` closure; the methods go as late-bound closures (`cascadeRelationBehavior`, `fileReferenceCheckElevation`, `probeReferencingRowsOfSet`, `deleteRestrictedError`, `referenceProbeFilter`, `validationMessageContext`, `dependentCountIsDisclosable`, `objectDisplayLabel`), so a double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches. No moved body assigns a field, so there is no setter (`6430872749` not needed). - **Series limits.** All five are private with declared return types, so each `.d.ts` line stays `private NAME;`. No moved body reads a private static, has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, calls `this.insert` / `this.update` / `this.delete`, or carries an `engine.ts#NAME` liveness pointer. - **Helpers, under the cut-14 seat ruling `6432376812`.** The bodies read `cascadeMemberKey`, `cascadeSetAdd`, `cascadeSetHas`, `declaredMultiValued` and the `CascadeDeleteSet` interface, all also read by bodies that stay (`cascadeDeleteRelations`, `walkReferencingRelations`, `countReferencingRowsOutside`, `resolveOptionDefault` and `probeReferencingRows` for `declaredMultiValued`). Each gains `export` in place, byte for byte otherwise, and the module imports them from `./engine.js` (values; the interface type-only). `cascadeReachOf` is read only by `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade`, so it moves with it, byte-identical. Nothing re-exports any of them from the package entry. - **Imports.** `renderOperationMessage` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) and `resolveFieldLabel` (`./validation/record-validator.js`) were read in `engine.ts` only by `deleteRestrictedError`, so they leave `engine.ts`'s import lists (one specifier each; both modules are still imported there for other names) and the module imports them. The module also imports `ServiceObject` and `ExecutionContext` as types. - **Load order (measured).** `engine.ts` imports the module right after cut 16's type import, after every module the new one imports, so no module is evaluated earlier than before. On the head bundles, with the `// src/engine.ts` markers set aside, the `// src/...` region order equals the base's with one line added, `// src/engine-delete-cascade.ts` (`index.mjs` 101 to 102 regions, `core.mjs` 90 to 91, `index.js` 102 to 103, `core.js` 91 to 92). The external modules load in the same first-occurrence order (`index.mjs` import specifiers, deduplicated in order: md5 `853c7898…` both). The ESM bundle has one more `import` statement (150 to 151 in `index.mjs`, 132 to 133 in `core.mjs`; CJS `require(` 150 to 151 / 132 to 133): the module's own `renderOperationMessage` import from `@objectstack/spec/system`, a package `engine.ts` already loads first, so no load moves. ### Net lines `engine.ts` goes from 22,110 to 21,874 lines, **net −236** (42 added, 278 removed). The module is 429 lines. The diff against `origin/main` is 753 changed lines over 4 files (+473 / −280). ### Readers of the moved lines - **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`**: `recordReferenceCheckElevation` holds row 29's elevation read (`context?.isSystem`). The register row is re-keyed from `engine.ts#recordReferenceCheckElevation` to `engine-delete-cascade.ts#recordReferenceCheckElevation` (moved to its sorted place); the row's own Symbol cell names the symbol only and is unchanged. `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`: OK (154 read sites, register matches the tree). - **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`**: one source citation, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#required`, named the `required` local of `deleteRestrictedError`; re-pointed to `engine-delete-cascade.ts#required`, its text otherwise unchanged. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: 13 judged, 0 lost; the full checklist gate: OK. - `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys name `cascadeRelationBehavior`, `planCascadeAtomicity`, `organizationOwnedRowCounts` and `isTenantColumnSetNull`, all of which stay; no moved body holds a seam use, and the test passes. `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` names `engine.ts#cascadeDeleteRelations`, which stays: nothing under `packages/spec` changes. - Prose mentions of moved names outside the package (`packages/spec` CHANGELOG/comments, `engine-cascade-delete.test.ts` and `delete-reference-cleanup-system-identity.test.ts` comments, a runtime integration test docblock naming `ObjectQL.refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade`) name the method by behaviour, and the method still exists on the class. - **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` at base and head: identical once line numbers are masked (165 lines). No moved body guards a storage read. - **No ADR anchor paragraph describes a moved body** (the `engine.ts` entry is the transaction-seam paragraph), so the module needs no anchor entry of its own. - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `c4c515ad3c` (clean checkout): **1,900** decision-letter citations on the anchored surface, 60,466 resolving citations across 8,527 files. At head: **1,900**, 60,466 across 8,528. The moved bodies carry no `[ADR-NNNN Dn]` letter. ## Why #25522 splits `engine.ts` one seam at a time so that a change to one area reads, reviews and conflicts as that area alone. The delete-cascade section is the largest section left and was free once #26930 merged. Nothing about what the engine does changes. ## Tests No test is added and none is edited: the move is proved by identity, not by new behaviour.
Public .d.ts: byte-identical (ruling 6348891160 item 1), with a positive control Built `@objectstack/objectql` at the base (`c4c515ad3c`, `engine.ts` blob `50a504332d70`, no module; `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/objectql...`, 14 of 14 tasks) and at head (`engine.ts` blob `a5687d70a2f0`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build`). The builds are the moved code, not a stale cache: `collectCascadeDeleteSet.call(host` and `// src/engine-delete-cascade.ts` each occur 0 times in the base `dist/index.mjs` and once in the head's. | file | sha256 base = head | raw-diff lines | |---|---|---| | `core.d.ts` | `bdc32f3004ee12903aba75d2f07929f8e8abdacc135f7ca65e6b66e625a16876` | 0 | | `core.d.mts` | `ae601360109a2117cbcac69f9a5d28c5334cdff8abed80b35057fe0dd41de73b` | 0 | | `index.d.ts` | `bcb31057f6f7e50f34792c621026e92bc95764160843924aa25c72c476073505` | 0 | | `index.d.mts` | `943aad8e39db6806e5585acd220b33be7219804cb27a225052b1feea873fb64e` | 0 | | `util-6U6fCMd3.d.ts` | `146d109c8c793af1dc26780171712da9570d87eef2e4fcadebfe32e62fb7fa37` | 0 | | `util-6U6fCMd3.d.mts` | `146d109c8c793af1dc26780171712da9570d87eef2e4fcadebfe32e62fb7fa37` | 0 | - Every declaration file is **raw byte-identical**, and no chunk is renamed (`util-6U6fCMd3` at both), so `6348891160` item 1 holds with no normalisation and the `6441032442` reorder bar is not reached. The `6441032442` normaliser (`dtsnorm.mjs`) lives in another project's files and was not available in this thread's container; with a 0-line raw diff on all six files there is nothing for it to normalise. - The run-time export lists are equal too: `index` 182 names and `core` 54, ESM and CJS, and a sha256 over every export's name and function `.name` is the same at base and head (`2aaa13a11288fd84…` / `70d1bf1f346b2793…`), so no bundler same-name rename happened. - (e) After the head build, the full `turbo run build` (115 of 115 tasks, the dependents' DTS builds included) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` ran: exit 0 each. (P2) `packages/objectql/package.json` `exports` names `./dist/index.*` and `./dist/core.*` only; (P3) `git grep -n -E 'objectql/dist|driver-sql/dist' -- scripts package.json`: 0 hits. **Positive control.** On the head, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` dropped `private` from ` private async deleteRestrictedError(args: {` (a moved member's stub; anchor 1 to 0, blob `a5687d70a2f0` to `1850f07b29d3`) and rebuilt (exit 0). The chunk is renamed `util-Dd_AzMXV` and now publishes `deleteRestrictedError(args: { object: string; … context: ExecutionContext | undefined; }): Promise` of `Error` (line 11117, where the head prints `private deleteRestrictedError;`); every declaration file's sha256 changes (`core.d.ts` `68f57645…`, `index.d.ts` `b9136807…`, chunk `519be62f…`). The restore leg put the blob back to `a5687d70a2f0` (`git diff HEAD` empty), and the rebuild that followed produced six declaration files and four bundles that compare equal to the head build.
AST compare (move-only) A one-off script (TypeScript compiler API; leaf tokens by recursive `getChildren`) on base `engine.ts` against head `engine.ts` plus the module: - The five moved bodies are **SAME** (parameters, return type, `async`, body tokens, and every body line equal after one level of indent): `referenceProbeFilter` 97 tokens / 13 lines, `recordReferenceCheckElevation` 107 / 24, `collectCascadeDeleteSet` 582 / 64, `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade` 810 / 74, `deleteRestrictedError` 323 / 81. Negative control: one changed token in the module copy (`slice(1, -1)` to `slice(1, -2)`) reads DIFF. - `class ObjectQL`: 330 of 330 members kept, in the same order; 325 byte-identical including leading trivia, and the 5 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature identical. - Top level: 229 of 238 base statements byte-identical. The other 9: the two import lists that lose one specifier; `declaredMultiValued`, `CascadeDeleteSet`, `cascadeMemberKey`, `cascadeSetHas` and `cascadeSetAdd`, each with `export` added and otherwise byte-identical; `cascadeReachOf`, moved into the module byte-identical; and the class. The head adds one statement: the module import.
Late-binding probe (base and head dist) `zz-probe-cut19.mjs` (a one-off, not committed) loads the built `ObjectQL` from each `dist/` and drives the five bodies with doubles set on the instance after construction: `referenceProbeFilter` on a single-valued lookup, a multi-valued lookup, an id needing JSON escaping (the `$or` arm) and a multiselect; `recordReferenceCheckElevation` with `userId`, `actor`, `isSystem` and no context, the `logger` replaced twice after construction; `collectCascadeDeleteSet` over a three-level master-detail fixture with every host member replaced and each call recorded in order, with and without `fileElevations`; `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade` on both sets after a second generation of doubles is wired (it reaches the second generation, and refuses through the replaced `deleteRestrictedError` with the replaced `referenceProbeFilter`'s filter); and the class's own `deleteRestrictedError` with its three host members replaced, for a `restrict` and a `required` relation, with count disclosure off and on. The 16 output lines are identical on base `c4c515ad3c` and head (the 5 construction log lines, which carry timestamps, set aside); stderr is empty on both.
Suites Under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: - Full `turbo run build`: 115 of 115 tasks, exit 0. - `typecheck` of `@objectstack/objectql` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) and `@objectstack/core`: exit 0 each. - `@objectstack/objectql` vitest `--project local`: 479 files, 8,942 tests passed, exit 0 (the `engine-cascade-delete*` files, `engine-cascade-reference-carrier.test.ts`, `engine-dangling-reference-audit.test.ts` and `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` among them). - Beyond the package, the real-driver cascade suites that run these bodies end to end: `@objectstack/runtime` `cascade-delete-multivalue-lookup-real-driver`, `cascade-delete-restrict-same-parent-real-driver` and `sandbox/referential-cascade-delete-signal` integration tests (3 files, 15 passed, 1 skipped), and `@objectstack/plugin-security` `delete-reference-cleanup-system-identity.test.ts` (18 passed). - `test:repo` projects were not run locally (the published surface is byte-identical); `Test Core` runs them in CI.

`--ran`: 80 derived, 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** ("a DERIVED zero — all 80 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3"). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:dts-closure` ran after the full build; `check-plugin-teardown-shape` and `check-engine-split-ratio --self-test` after deepening the clone to 2026-07-22 and fetching `621a4876`. - **Hand gates, exit 0 each:** `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` (counts above), `node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` (245 write call sites), `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` (2,798 anchors), `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` and the full `check-platform-checklist.mjs`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`, `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`, `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`, `node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs --list` (base and head identical, masked), and eslint as `pnpm lint` runs it (`--no-inline-config`) on `packages/objectql`. - After `origin/main` `7e200b4a68` was merged (15 files under `ui/` and the Studio, none of this diff's paths), the change set against `origin/main` is the same four files, so the derived list is unchanged. ## Acceptance notes - **Serial order.** Nothing was edited before the claim `6487687348` named this branch. - **Overlap.** Open PRs touching `packages/objectql/**` or this diff's docs, listed at start and again just before opening this (each head fetched, `git diff --name-only origin/main...pr/N`): draft #27339 edits `engine.ts` at its import block (right after cut 18's import), `insert`, `update` and `aggregate`, none of this section, the five exported helpers or the two edited import lists; `git merge-tree` of this head with #27339's head is clean. #27344 adds rows to `system-context.mdx` in other places and auto-merges with this head. The branch #27277's claim named, `claude/project-thread-mlrxgx`, does not exist on the remote (`git ls-remote`: 0 refs), so there was nothing to read there. Whichever lands second merges `main`. - **What stays, for the next cut.** Seventeen members of this section stay for the private-static limit; the largest, `walkReferencingRelations` (318 body lines), cannot move under the current series limits. `cascadeRelationBehavior` (60) stays for the reader test's same-file `via` rule. - **Left as is.** `engine.ts`'s `CascadeDeleteSet` docblock and `refuseRestrictsInsideOwnCascade`'s docblock still say `{@link cascadeReachOf}`, which now lives in the module; they are left byte-identical, as cut 14 left a `{@link}` to a helper that moved.
